After conversion callbacks recheck token, atom._mol, _uid_owner, UID, row membership and topology row; prepared updates also recheck requested N01 content domains. Rebind the current table after callback growth.

With same-owner outer transaction, capture and append a complete physical undo entry before stores; current-entry restoration uses that capture and every native failure poisons the outer even when caught.
Root ordinary scalar may use fixed-size call-local undo for one field and declared groups; use the same installer/restorer, no Python transaction object/ContextVar cycle or retained journal.

Values, source, presence, status and seed add/remove changes all rollback for BaseException/KeyboardInterrupt/MemoryError/native allocation failure; readonly checks and undo enrollment occur before stores.
Outer eager element/Bond/batch bodies preserve ordering, producer inheritance and named codes; no user callbacks between first direct store and completion of an immediate native install.
Ordered physical undo handles overlap/growth/remap/removal and original member identities; UID high-water never rewinds; no whole-table scalar copies or raw-equality skip.
decision.compiled_core_dispatch: Allowed native Atom.__setattr__ canonical dispatch to direct scalar ingress; preserve Atom.n/all getters, atomic_number eager body, sparse/default attributes and Bond dispatch.
